resources.string: Wi-Fi name to treat as local (SSID)

Off by default. Android protects a service that shows a notification far better than one that does not, so turning this on makes switching happen straight away instead of waiting for the periodic check. The cost is a permanent entry in the notification shade.
Notification shown — the service is kept in the foreground.
No notification — the service may be stopped when the phone is idle, and switching falls back to the periodic check.
Service running — Private DNS follows your Wi-Fi network.
The service is not updating. Android may have stopped it — press Restart.
Missing permission — follow the steps below.
Missing permission to read the Wi-Fi network name. Grant location, or nearby devices on Android 13+.
Location is set to "Only while using the app", so the Wi-Fi name is hidden from the service when this screen is closed. Set Location to "Allow all the time".
The phone still hides the Wi-Fi name from this app. Some Android builds cannot be worked around.

Android treats the Wi-Fi name as location data, so an app that is not on screen cannot read it unless Location is set to "Allow all the time".\n\nWith the current setting the switch only works while this screen is open. Open the app settings and choose Location, then Allow all the time.
Could not open settings. Find the app under Settings, then Permissions, then Location.

IMPORTANT
Grant the ADB permission once:

adb shell pm grant com.rickmschulz.dnsautoswitcher android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS

Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO (MIUI / HyperOS): the command is rejected unless you also enable Developer options → “USB debugging (Security settings)”.
The app cannot read your Wi-Fi name. Some phones need Location access for that — allow it so the switch can work.
CRITICAL: choose \'Allow all the time\' so the background service can read the Wi-Fi name.
Shows which state Private DNS is in.
%1$s — local DNS in use, Private DNS off
On your configured network — local DNS in use, Private DNS off
Private DNS on — not on your configured network
Cannot monitor the network — restart the app
Cannot read the Wi-Fi name — check the permissions
Wi-Fi seen: unreadable — grant Location (or Nearby devices) access
